name: Yokoshiba (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yokoshiba town emblem in white: a ring divided by a vertical bar with angular strokes, like a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Yokoshiba in Chiba Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-27.

features.role: Yokoshiba town emblem — a ring divided by a vertical bar with angular strokes, like a stylised character
